title: Hello, I am Nour
lead: A journalism and digital media student with strong expertise in storytelling, content creation and multimedia communication.
portraitCaption: Nour Wehbi reporting at the Fourth International Conference on Digital Journalism and Innovative Media Industry
body: A curious mind who captures stories through words, visuals and emotion, who believes that every voice has a story worth telling, and that we are the voice of the voiceless.
My work bridges traditional reporting with modern digital platforms, focusing on delivering engaging, credible and visually compelling stories.
I have experience in writing news articles, capturing meaningful photos, producing video features and managing social media content with an eye for accuracy and creativity.
Passionate about media innovation, I am constantly exploring how technology can enhance storytelling and connect audiences across different platforms.
Outside of media, I enjoy reading, cooking, swimming, photography and exploring new creative ideas.
closing: Feel free to explore my portfolio and get in touch if you would like to collaborate — or just chat about creative ideas.
